scope: Experimental JDBC authorization checkpoints, shared model usage and root flow state; opt-in

dependencies.productionDriver: Host-supplied JDBC DataSource; no production driver bundled

coordination.authority: One root row transaction and row lock, no in-process authoritative balance cache
coordination.sourceHandoff: Reject queued/running/post-check-pending governed operations and unresolved local usage; bind source snapshots and output checks to authoritative views
coordination.restore: Pure state reconstruction; no model/tool/data side-effect replay; no automatic lease revival
coordination.catalog: Persistent stable catalog UUID must match original binding
coordination.capacity: Persistent blocked marker when updated snapshot cannot fit; larger-limit instances cannot bypass marker

twoJvmScenario.transport: Independent SDK worker JVMs with separate JDBC registry instances coordinated through loopback H2 TCP; synthetic model functions
twoJvmScenario.price: Fixed synthetic test price, not a production bill

killedWorkerScenario.failure: Forcibly kill JVM after dispatch enters native function

failureScenarios: Commit succeeds but acknowledgement is lost: return unavailable, keep dispatch in persistent ledger
Commit finishes after lease deadline: deny admission; observed time prevents rollback revival
Expired or explicitly ended dispatched call retains upper-bound hold and freezes root
Prepared call can be released; closing a worker cannot reset settled consumption
Model identity mismatch or exceeded actual bounds persist failure instead of rolling back
Concurrent registry instances cannot multiply single-use grants or token reservations
Duplicate root registration cannot reset consumption
Missing schema or damaged/inconsistent checkpoint has no empty-state fallback
Wrong catalog, tenant, principal or missing inspection permission is denied
Checkpoint capacity exhaustion persists blocked root even for larger-limit instances
Authority shutdown waits boundedly for started heartbeat tasks before storage teardown
limitations: Only H2 SQL/transactions tested; production database adaptation and HA/failover not verified
Whole-root snapshot per transaction; large graph/high throughput capacity not verified
Host must authenticate control-plane and inspection callers, provide TLS/IAM and protect DB credentials
Checksum detects corruption but does not prevent privileged DB tampering or rollback
Checkpoint contains identity/resource/policy metadata; encryption, retention and tamper-evident audit remain pending
No automatic task resume, unknown-bill reconciliation, side-effect replay/rollback or external cancellation confirmation
Label catalog update and authorization checkpoint are separate conservative transactions
Complete hardening plan including finer data provenance and P1 remains active

verification.skipReason: Optional real-provider test is not enabled
